_provenance: generated from the sector137 server code at commit 4ef96f3 (packages/mcp, ops domain, served at /mcp/ops) by an in-memory MCP client calling tools/list; not captured from a deployed server

tools.name: create_initiative
tools.description: Create an initiative — the PHASE container. A bounded body of cross-cutting work (e.g. 'launch onboarding v2') that issues get linked into. It owns nothing; link issues to it to roll up feature lead time.

tools.name: get_dora_metrics
tools.description: Get the four DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, Change Failure Rate, MTTR) over a window, rolled up across the product(s) in scope. Lead Time is null until commit timestamps are captured.

tools.name: get_initiative_dora
tools.description: Get initiative-grain DORA: feature lead time (first work → last deploy that shipped it) and cross-service change-failure rate (did shipping this break any of its services). Computed via the issues.releaseId → deployment bootstrap; null lead time means no linked release has shipped yet.

tools.name: get_service_dora
tools.description: Get the four DORA metrics for a single service over a window (the service grain). Deploys/incidents scope by serviceId; Lead Time joins via the service's linked repo and is null when no repo is linked. Use list_services to find the serviceId.

tools.name: link_issue_to_initiative
tools.description: Link an issue to an initiative so its delivery facts (releases → deploys) roll into the initiative's feature lead time. Idempotent.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List recent incidents for the product(s) in scope.

tools.name: list_initiative_issues
tools.description: List the issues linked to an initiative — the work that makes up this phase. Read this before reporting phase progress or computing its DORA slice; the initiative holds no facts of its own.

tools.name: list_initiatives
tools.description: List initiatives (bounded, cross-cutting work overlays) for the product(s) in scope.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services in the delivery catalog (auto-created from deploy ingest). Use this to find a serviceId before calling get_service_dora.

tools.name: record_deployment
tools.description: Record a deployment fact (a service reached an environment). Distinct from a release. The service is auto-cataloged from serviceKey.

tools.name: record_incident
tools.description: Open an incident (a production failure). Link it to the deployment that caused it to drive Change Failure Rate.

tools.name: resolve_incident
tools.description: Mark an incident resolved (stops the MTTR clock).

tools.name: unlink_issue_from_initiative
tools.description: Remove an issue from an initiative — take work out of a phase. The issue itself is untouched; only the link (and so the initiative's DORA slice) changes. Idempotent.

tools.name: update_initiative
tools.description: Update an initiative — this is how a PHASE is transitioned: planned → active → shipped (or abandoned). Without it a phase can be created but never moved. Also edits the name, description and dates. Only the fields you pass are changed.
